name: OEM / Private-Label Peptide Documentation Handover Checklist

stages.pre-award: before the supply agreement is signed
stages.handover: at the end of the supply relationship

binding_definition.contractual: should be an explicit deliverable in the supply agreement

items.item: Specification sheet (identity, sequence, salt form, declared purity basis)
items.cost_if_missing: Buyer cannot verify the article received against what was contracted; disputes become unresolvable in practice.

items.item: Quality agreement (responsibilities, deviation notification, audit rights)
items.cost_if_missing: Deviation handling is undefined; the manufacturer decides what to disclose.

items.item: Change-control notice period and change classes
items.cost_if_missing: Silent changes to synthesis route, salt form or supplier cascade into the buyer's product without notice.

items.item: Method description for purity determination (column, gradient, wavelength)
items.cost_if_missing: Purity numbers are not comparable between batches or between suppliers.

items.item: Certificate of analysis for the first article batch
items.cost_if_missing: No baseline exists for routine supply; every later CoA is judged in isolation.

items.item: Mass spectrometry report with observed and theoretical mass
items.cost_if_missing: Identity claim rests on a single measurement without a comparison reference.

items.item: Residual solvent / counter-ion data (e.g. TFA content)
items.cost_if_missing: Downstream assay reproducibility suffers; salt form effects appear as unexplained variability.

items.item: Handling, solubility and storage instruction sheet
items.cost_if_missing: Product is mishandled in the buyer's own storage chain, then blamed on the supplier.

items.item: Named testing laboratory, with accreditation identifier where available
items.cost_if_missing: Third-party data cannot be verified or re-queried.

items.item: Artwork, labelling and translation approval trail
items.cost_if_missing: Label claims drift from the approved content; regulatory exposure sits with the label holder.

items.item: Batch record / batch-level traceability (sequence, purification, lyophilisation)
items.cost_if_missing: Root-cause investigation after a complaint is limited to what the supplier chooses to share.

items.item: Stability data and retest interval, with storage conditions tested
items.cost_if_missing: Expiry dating is assumed rather than supported.

items.item: Deviation and out-of-specification notification in practice, not only on paper
items.cost_if_missing: Recall scope cannot be bounded quickly because notification history does not exist.
Specifications age silently; the buyer discovers stale claims during an audit.

items.item: Full document set transfer (specs, methods, batch records, CoAs)
items.cost_if_missing: Handbook ends with the supplier relationship; the buyer cannot reproduce the product.

items.item: Reference standards or retained samples of the last accepted batches
items.cost_if_missing: No comparison baseline exists for qualifying the next supplier.

items.item: Method transfer package for the replacement manufacturer
items.cost_if_missing: Requalification restarts from scratch; months are lost to method development.

items.item: Open deviation register and complaint history
items.cost_if_missing: Known weaknesses are rediscovered by the next manufacturer through failure.

items.item: Confirmation of residual obligations (confidentiality, non-compete, warranty period)
items.cost_if_missing: Post-termination obligations are ambiguous at the moment they matter.

how_to_use: Mark each contractual item: obtained / promised / absent, per supplier.
Score per stage rather than overall - a missing handover item is invisible until the relationship ends.
Attach the 'cost if missing' column to the negotiation, not the audit: it states the consequence in the buyer's terms.
